english.note: Use 表演 as the all-purpose noun for a live show or concert.
Use this for a show or spectacle put on for an audience.
Use this for the performance itself, especially when performers are presenting something to an audience rather than referring to the whole program.

examples.traditional: 今晚嘅表演真係好精彩。

examples.english: Their performance was great entertainment for the whole audience.
examples.traditional: 佢哋嘅表演令全場觀眾都笑晒。
